name: Stream-able
description: A recording, livestreaming and multistreaming studio inside Minecraft: ultrawide-aware program canvas, independent recording and stream outputs, broadcast microphone processing with local AI noise cancellation, a destination tester, and interactive Chromium browser sources. Runtimes (FFmpeg, Chromium, ONNX Runtime) are installed and verified automatically. Derived from Record-able by JoEusebe.
contributors: JoEusebe (Record-able, the project this is derived from)

custom.streamable:bundled: MCEF Modern (LGPL-2.1) and XZ for Java (0BSD) are bundled as separate Jar-in-Jar libraries; see NOTICE.
